steps.caption: Option 5A · One Inbox. Three panels become one, with one count.
The strip is Inbox, Ask and capture. The badge adds up everything that waits.
Needs you, Suggested, Captured: three sections, one place to check.
The old keys still work: ⌥⌘K lands on Captured. Arrows walk every row.
A page with suggestions floats its “On this page” rows to the top. The pin keeps the order.
One door for attention, instead of three.
